title: API review
objectives: Map API routes and authentication requirements from source and configuration.
Triage injection and access-control findings with exploitability notes.
Confirm error responses and CORS behavior on observed traffic only.
Record accepted risks and follow-up scans for the next release.

scope.notes: Review-only: static analysis of the snapshot plus passive observation of the declared target. No active probing, no fuzzing, no credential use. Replace the example host with the real engagement host before use.
